findings.subject: include/game/screen.h:10-13; src/pilot/game_heap.cpp:6-14
findings.title: Give the UI widget a distinct type from the graphics factory object
findings.summary: Completing global struct Widget here also completes the accepted C++ Widget forward declaration in game_heap.cpp:6: extern-C linkage does not create a type namespace. That factory requests 0x48 bytes and returns the same constructor storage, whereas the new UI layout has sizeof(Widget)==0x94 and func_0017a9a0 reads its selector at +0x92. These are incompatible recovered object-storage contracts advertised as one C++ type. Keep the UI and graphics objects distinct by tag or namespace, revising the accepted factory if its opaque type is renamed. This is a whole-ledger source/type defect, not a claim that the unchanged original machine code now crashes; independent per-unit matching cannot detect it.
